messages:
mike: Scheduling a 45m workshop tomorrow to finalize the long-term routing + multi-tenant isolation roadmap. Goal: concrete spec items, launch criteria, prioritized customer asks (Acme, FinApps, Healthcare). Bring one slide + deps.
maya: +1. Please include Dedicated/Private rollout constraints—customers ask about data residency and deterministic latency.
vikram: Spec proposal: add model-aware routing matrix (kernel/quant compat), explicit fallback order, and per-tenant KV cache migration cost calc.
nana: Observability must be an acceptance gate: token-level traces, per-route p95, model-variant cost attribution, and trace-id propagation.
sara: Draft acceptance gates: cross-region fallback adds <200ms p95; canary for 1% tenant-slice with automated fallback; console surfaces token cost by model/route; documented migration & rollback playbooks.
kim: Priorities: (1) isolation lanes for regulated customers, (2) low-latency affinity lanes, (3) cost-optimized shared lanes. Map lanes to Dedicated/Private availability windows.
mike: Action: drop 3 bullets each (customer ask, hard dep, gate). I'll synthesize into a strawman.
maya: Acme ask: pinned model variants per region + 99.9 latency SLA. Dep: Dedicated pools + KMS. Gate: per-region SLA test harness.
vikram: FinApps ask: predictable token economics for reranking-heavy workloads. Dep: batching + quant profiles + optimizer passes. Gate: perf regression <5% vs baseline and docs on quant tradeoffs.
nana: Healthcare ask: VPC/on-prem + audit logs. Dep: Private control plane + HSM. Gate: SOC-like audit trail + e2e deploy runbook.
sara: Ops gate: eviction & auto-fallback runbook, SLO docs, synthetic prompt set for quality regression checks and auto-rollback triggers.
mike: Workshop agenda: 1) customer asks + deps (15m) 2) draft spec & canary patterns (15m) 3) acceptance gates & telemetry (10m) 4) timeline & owners (5m).
